notes: A firing now COMPETES. Wave 3 made a rule cause one proposal; it could not make several proposals interact, because what makes them interact is a POLICY — how much of the book one name may take, how many names may be held at once, what happens when more candidates signal than fit, what the uninvested cash earns, and when the whole thing is brought back to its targets. This release is Wave 4 of EVENT-PROCESSING-SPEC.md: the strategy object, the completed sizing union, the constraint set, the ranking law, the cash policy and the daily loop that turns a day's firings into a managed paper book.
